text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Something's missing.
If only I had just one more piece...)
I came up with some ideas regarding training and was jotting them down in my notebook, but—

It dragged on and on,
and before long, my eyelids grew heavy...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...She's totally asleep.
Tch, guess it'll have to wait until tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(――...Might be somewhat useful.
Guess I'll give it a shot.)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Man, though... you look awful.
Your complexion is terrible, and your skin is so dry."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Passion's great and all,
but you gotta think about how ya look too.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Come to think of it—
was there lip balm in my pocket?)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (At least this should help with the dryness. ...All right.)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Haha, a reward from the master.

A short while later, I woke up...
and noticed a wonderful aroma drifting through the air.
I wasn't sure of the reason, but my spirits felt a little brighter.
